title: Paper Network — Cutout Animation preview

scenes.title: An idea becomes a connected system
scenes.purpose: Show cut-paper construction on a scene-dependent slate planning board: placing, hinged pose replacement, a procedural fold that opens each card and kraft strips unrolling into a network.
visuals: Stationary deep slate-teal planning board of torn paper bands with faint grid and grain
Torn kraft bulb with cream filament, charcoal base strips and mustard paper rays
Four cream node cards that land folded and unfold with a curling crease
Kraft connector strips that unroll from a shrinking paper roll
Three headline strips: 'An idea', 'becomes a', 'connected system'

beats.development: 'An idea' strip is pressed onto the board; the bulb swings down on its base pivot and settles.
Filament flickers through held poses to lit and paper rays appear; 'becomes a' lands; the first two folded cards are placed and strips start unrolling from the bulb ports.
Cards one and three unfold, then get their inked icons; cards two and four land folded and the next strips unroll toward them.
Last cards unfold and get icons, the closing strip joins card two to card four, and 'connected system' is pressed into place.
Everything holds still so the whole headline and network can be read.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

findings: One focal action at a time with overlapping secondary placements; all motion settles by 2.35 s, before the 2.7 s requirement.
Icons stay hidden until their card's fold completes, so no label appears before its container.
justifiedHolds: 2.35–3.0 s final reading hold for the six-word headline and finished network.

notes: Background is scene-dependent (slate planning board), following BACKGROUND_REVIEW lessons: the field belongs to the scene while white torn cores, matte grain and soft contact shadows define the medium.
